scripts.validate: GATE_NAME=validate bash scripts/uv-script.sh scripts/render.py --check && dir=$(mktemp -d) && trees=$(bash scripts/uv-script.sh scripts/render.py --trees | cut -d' ' -f2) && for t in $trees; do kustomize build "$t" || exit 1; echo '---'; done > "$dir/cluster.yaml" && kubeconform -strict -ignore-missing-schemas -schema-location default -schema-location 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datreeio/CRDs-catalog/main/{{.Group}}/{{.ResourceKind}}_{{.ResourceAPIVersion}}.json' -summary "$dir/cluster.yaml" > "$dir/report"; rc=$?; cat "$dir/report"; if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && grep -q '^Summary: 0 resource' "$dir/report"; then bash scripts/gate.sh nothing validate '0 resources' 'run `devbox run render` and check that cluster/kustomization.yaml lists resources'; rc=1; fi; rm -rf "$dir"; exit $rc
scripts.secrets-scan: bash scripts/gate.sh files secrets-scan . && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 detect-secrets-hook --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --exclude-files copier-answers --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.secrets-baseline: grep -qs is_line_allowlisted .secrets.baseline.json || detect-secrets scan --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret > .secrets.baseline.json; detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret
scripts.ci: devbox run validate && devbox run check && devbox run security && if grep -qs '"ci-extra"[[:space:]]*:' devbox.json; then devbox run ci-extra; fi
